Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 20-Jun-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
 SIXTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE  
  2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 3251/ECE_3251 - COMMUNICATION NETWORKS  
  COMMUNICATION NETWORKS [ECE 3251]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)                Explain in detail about the functions of ISO: OSI reference model.                                    (4)  
1B)                Represent the bit stream "00100111" using the following line encoding techniques: i) Manchester ii) (3)  
  Differential Manchester iii) NRZ-I  
1C)                We have four data sources to be multiplexed using synchronous TDM; Each source generates 512 (3)  
  characters per sec. If the interleaved unit is a single character and one synchronizing bit is added to  
  each frame, find: i) input character duration ii) output character duration iii) frame rate iv) frame  
  duration v) frame size vi) channel rate.  
2A)                Form the codeword for the transmitting data stream 110101101100 using CRC if the generator bit        (4)  
  stream is 11010.  
2B)                Compute checksum of the following IPv4 packet header.                                                 (3)  
  
  
2C)                On a 10Mbps satellite channel with 270msec delay, frames are transmitted with each of size 10KB. (3)  
  Compute the link utilization using the following ARQ techniques: Stop-and-Wait, Go-back-N, and  
  Selective-Repeat with window size of 7 and error probability of 10-4.  
  
3A)                Ten thousand nodes are competing for the use of a single slotted ALOHA channel. On average,         (4)  
  each node makes fifteen requests per hour. If the slot duration is 128µsec, what is the approximate  
  total channel load?  
3B)                Discuss the functioning of CSMA/CD with help of its flow diagram.                                     (3)  
3C)                Draw the frame structure of FDDI and mention the functions of each field in detail.                   (3)  
4A)                Using Dijkstra's algorithm, find the least cost from node 1 to all other nodes in the network given   (4)  
  below. Show the routing updates in the form of a table.  
  
  
  Page 1 of 2

4B)   For the following subnet, establish the complete routing table maintained at node 'B' using Distance (3)  
  Vector Routing algorithm. Mention the routing updates.  
  
  
4C)   With a block diagram, illustrate every field of the IPv6 frame format.                               (3)  
5A)   A university is granted a block of addresses with the beginning address 14.24.74.0/24. The           (4)  
  university needs to have 3 sub-blocks of addresses to use in its three subnets:  
  i) sub-block of 120 addresses,  
  ii) sub-block of 60 addresses,  
  iii) sub-block of 10 addresses.  
  Design the sub-blocks and also mention how many addresses are left out.  
5B)   Explain the different categories of web documents in HTTP.                                           (3)  
5C)   Briefly explain the 3 components of DNS.                                                             (3)  
  
  
  -----End-----  
  
  
  Page 2 of 2
